title: Mean of a restricted slice
statement: Let $g$ be a function from the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube to $-1,1$. Leave all coordinates except coordinate $0$ free, and fix coordinate $0$ to a sign $b$. The mean, over the free coordinates, of the restricted function's real-valued sign equals the mean of the $n$-variable slice of $g$ obtained by fixing its first coordinate to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
The free coordinates are all coordinates except coordinate $0$
A fixed sign assignment on the sole remaining coordinate
